tokenName: First Alliance Bank Mortgage Mortgage-Backed Token
description: Tokenised mortgage-backed security issued by First Alliance Bank Mortgage. Each token represents a fractional interest in a pool of performing residential mortgage loans in Zambia.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Mortgage Finance Act; Financial Sector Tokenisation Rules 2024

tokenName: First Alliance Bank Mortgage Property Title Token
description: Digital property title token issued by First Alliance Bank Mortgage representing a blockchain-recorded property deed. Enables transparent and efficient property transactions in Zambia.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Land Registry Act; Digital Property Title Framework 2024
